items.title: Dave McKenna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I wonder if you’ve ever heard the record he made with Zoot and J.J. and Lockjaw Davis, ooh, and Count Basie.

ctx.x: And as far as the old blues singers, I like Joe Turner, Big Joe Turner. I wonder if you’ve ever heard the record he made with Zoot and J.J. and Lockjaw Davis, ooh, and Count Basie. Yeah. Oh.
What was it about Basie that just kept him for years—
